Source: https://github.com/DSuzuki35/horizonlock-vr
Reference commit: `0b2d88ae64d28907a72eb95b8920c7f90a7a42ae`.
Imported files: `core.hpp` and `core.cpp`; the include path was adapted for OpenGrid XR.
